title: OxCAM lathe fitting, version 1
description: What is fitted to a lathe for a job: a tooling block on a turret station, or a centre in the tailstock's quill. Lengths in mm, in the model's coordinates. 'step' is the SHA-256 of its STEP file, its exact geometry. A block's 'seat' is the point on the station's seat with the direction out of the turret, and 'mount' a point on the tool's centre line at the block's mouth with the direction towards the tip, which 'overhang' mm further on is where the tip stands. A centre's 'seat' is where it sits in the quill, and 'mount' its tip. 'shank' and 'bore' say what a block takes (0 = anything).
